symptom: `list java actions in System` showed System.VerifyPassword, but `describe java action System.VerifyPassword` failed with "java action not found: System.VerifyPassword", and exec of a microflow calling it logged "warning: could not look up Java action System.VerifyPassword: java action not found ... (entity type params will be empty)"
cause: ReadJavaActionByName only scanned stored JavaAction units, after first resolving the module by name, which fails for System since it has no stored module unit; the System built-ins are virtual (meta.SystemJavaActions) and were synthesized on the list paths only
insight: Virtual System-module members have to be synthesized on EVERY read path of a doctype, not just the list path: when one is fixed, grep the backend for the matching by-name reader. The fallback must also sit before the module lookup, because GetModuleByName("System") returns nothing. Stored units still win, and an unknown System.X stays 'not found' (the test's control).
